result.description: Howard Porter  Motor Mechanic  STEELBRO/Howard Porter is currently seeking skilled a Motor Mechanic to join a dynamic Repairs and Services team in a full time mechanical role offered by the Company and based in Lytton 4178 Brisbane, Queensland. Applicants will fault find and implement mechanical based solutions for the servicing and repairs of mainly Sideloaders. Post service, tests of mechanical systems and assembles are then required.    Other tasks may include:    Test and fault find equipment and prepare for service and repair,    Selecting tools and equipment,  Carry out service and repairs to sideloaders,  Inspection and test service and repairs before client handover,   Ensuring that all completed works is finished and within specifications, regulations, and contract provisions.    Successful applicants will likely have:     Competence in the repairs and service of vehicles,   Able to fault find and implement mechanical solutions to repair and rectify identified faults,  Have good knowledge of hydraulics and general mechanics, automotive and mobile plant.  Good sense and ability in fault finding and solutions generation and implementation,   Able to follow correct procedures & processes,   Good working knowledge of OS&H and Environmental practices       Skills, Qualifications and Experience:     Related or relevant associate degree, diploma or advance diploma,   Related or relevant associate degree, diploma or advanced diploma,   AQF Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or equivalent or higher related qualification or related skill level experience  Minimum 3 years’ experience.    Remuneration/Salary   $75,000 to $85,000 per annum  Remuneration will reflect current market conditions and industry award rates. To be discussed with the successful applicant.      Application   Expressions of interest and applications will be accepted for at least 1 month from placement of this advertisement  Apply NOW!  About Company     Howard Porter was founded in Fremantle in 1936 and today is building quality transport equipment for the mining, resources and transport industries. The Company is greatly recognized throughout Australia for its historical achievements and builds and delivers a comprehensive range of quality transport equipment.   In 2015, the company made a significant acquisition with the purchase of STEELBRO, the world’s premier provider of side-lifter container handling equipment. With a legacy of over 136 years of manufacturing excellence, STEELBRO’s reputation for design innovation has solidified its place as a global leader in container transport solutions. This acquisition was a key step in Howard Porter’s mission to strengthen its global footprint and establish a presence both in Australia and abroad.  As part of its continued expansion, Howard Porter and STEELBRO opened its first sales, service, and repairs center in Queensland in 2019, followed by a second location soon after in New South Wales and then later in Victoria. This continued growth reflects the company’s commitment to exploring new markets, developing new products, and driving continual improvement principles that are the core of Howard Porter’s success and market leadership for nearly a century.
